outcome: Quality of life assessed using Saint George’s Respiratory Questionnaire (SGRQ), total score at the end of the 12-month follow-up

citations.text: The questionnaires were those used by Casas et al. 18 with additions designed to capture patient empowerment characteristics: mental status,29 activities of daily living,30,31 anxiety and depression,32 health-related quality of life,33 Epworth sleepiness scale,34,35 6-min walking test,36 nocturnal pulse oximetry and measurement of body mass distribution using bioelectric impedance.37
SGRQ, Saint George’s Respiratory Questionnaire to assess health-related quality of life

Comparisons between the two study groups on admission and at 12 months were performed using unpaired Student's t-test for continuous variables and Χ 2-tests for non-continuous variables. Changes within each group were assessed by paired analysis.
